# Reference Documents

This folder contains the authoritative source documents for the Figma Make prompt pack specification.

## Source Specifications (Six Authoritative Files)

These six documents serve as the foundation for all Figma Make prompts and design system specifications:

1. **01-book-website-specification.md** — Master execution contract for Figma Make staged prompt pack (v1.0.0)
2. **02-companion-session-plan.md** — Figma Make companion session plan (v1.0.4)
3. **03-author-decisions-launch-scope.md** — Book website brief and author decisions (v1.3.0)
4. **04-design-brief.md** — Design brief and baseline specifications (v1.1.2)
5. **05-design-reader-decision-register.md** — Design and reader decision register (v1.9.0)
6. **06-website-reading-prd.md** — Product requirements documentation (v1.1.1)

## Supporting Documents

Additional reference materials for the Figma Make specification:

7. **07-toa-figma-make-companion-session-plan.md** — Companion session planning guide
8. **08-toa-figma-make-specification-prompt-pack.md** — Figma Make specification and prompt pack overview
9. **09-toa-figma-make-delivery-specification.md** — Delivery specification and persistence prompt
10. **10-toa-prd-website-reading-experience.md** — Product requirements for website and reading experience
11. **11-toa-figma-make.md** — Figma Make implementation guide
12. **12-toa-claude-prompt.md** — Claude prompt specifications
13. **13-this-one-time-on-acid-brief.md** — This One Time On Acid project brief

## Usage

These reference documents are cited throughout the specification in:
- `.github/specs/004-book-website-make/spec.md`
- `.github/specs/004-book-website-make/plan.md`
- `.github/specs/004-book-website-make/contracts/` (all prompt contracts)

Each contract links to the relevant reference document for context and source authority.
